title: Affine tensor coordinates for an intersection descent overlap
statement: Let $r:R\to A$ be a ring map, $X=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], $V\to X$ a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and $D$ a descent datum on $V/X$ relative to $X\to S$ [def-pd-descent-datum]. Define its overlap map $\varphi_D:V\times_S X\to X\times_S V$ [def-pc-fibre-product] by its projections: the first is the $X$-structure map of the first $V$-projection and the second is the universal transport $D.\mathrm{toHom}$. For any family $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ of opens of $V$, put $E=\bigcap_i U_i$, $C=\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_V|_E)$ [def-a1-intersection-structure-sections], with its scalar maps and tensor comparison from [def-a1-intersection-section-tensor-comparison]. Define the left-position tensor ring $A\otimes_R C$, its pure tensors $a\otimes c$, and the swap $A\otimes_R C\to C\otimes_R A$, $a\otimes c\mapsto c\otimes a$. Define the left comparison $A\otimes_R C\to\Gamma(X\times_S E,\mathcal O_{X\times_S V}|_{X\times_S E})$ as this swap followed by the canonical right-position base-change map and section pullback along the pullback-symmetry isomorphism. Define the affine model $Z=\operatorname{Spec}C\to X$ using the actual scalar map $A\to C$ induced by $V\to X$, and the canonical tensor-spectrum isomorphism $Z\times_S X\cong\operatorname{Spec}(C\otimes_R A)$. These are constructions only; no invariance, flatness, compactness, nonempty-family, cocycle-on-$Z$, or effectivity assertion is included.
